current_status.from: Active; on 2026-04-20 City Council unanimously adopted a permanent municipal-code ordinance prohibiting data centers citywide and declaring data centers a public nuisance, and placed companion Measure NDC on the 2026-06-02 special election ballot [VERIFY 2026-06-02 ballot result; election not yet held as of 2026-04-29]
current_status.to: Active; permanent citywide data center prohibition in place. Measure NDC passed at the June 2, 2026 special election (10,388 Yes / 1,372 No, per the LA County Registrar-Recorder's certified canvass); results certified by the City Clerk on June 30, 2026 and declared by City Council Resolution No. 2026-R56 on July 1, 2026 (unanimous, 5-0). Companion Ordinance No. 2280 (General Plan amendment prohibiting all data centers citywide) was adopted by Council on July 2, 2026, effective on or about July 11, 2026 (10 days after election-result certification, per Elections Code section 9217).
current_status.reason: City of Monterey Park's own Resolution No. 2026-R56 bundles the City Clerk's certification of election results, the LA County Registrar-Recorder's canvass certificate, and precinct-level vote totals, establishing that Measure NDC passed.
